name: Macau

fees.name: Visa on arrival (Authorization to Enter and Stay) - individual, single entry
fees.applies: nationalities not visa-exempt (except BGD, NPL, NGA, PAK, LKA, VNM who must apply in advance)
fees.notes: Issued at border checkpoints by the Public Security Police Force (CPSP) Immigration Department.

fees.name: Visa on arrival - individual, multiple entry
Visa on arrival - family passport
fees.applies: family travelling on a single family passport

fees.name: Visa on arrival - child under 12 (individual passport)
Visa on arrival - group (10+ persons, collective travel document)
fees.applies: groups of at least 10 organized by a single travel manager, per person

fees.name: Advance Macau visa via Chinese embassy/consulate
fees.applies: nationals of BGD, NPL, NGA, PAK, LKA, VNM (must apply in advance) and anyone applying pre-travel
fees.notes: Fee is set by the individual Chinese diplomatic mission and varies by mission and nationality; no single official published amount, so left null.

reciprocity_variations.note: Not eligible for visa on arrival; must obtain a Macau visa in advance through a Chinese embassy/consulate. Fee varies by mission.

free_visa_notes: Nationals of 88 countries/territories (incl. USA, GBR, CAN, AUS, JPN, SGP, EU states) are visa-exempt for stays of 14-180 days depending on nationality; Hong Kong and mainland Chinese residents use separate permit schemes. Visa-exempt entry has no fee.
